guidance.bestFor: The whole selector laid inline in a Card with typed entry, and a JSON readout of the value under it
agentNotes: The `JSON.stringify` panel under the Card is a demo readout of `value`; remove it once `value` feeds your form

whenNotToUse.when: A compact field that stays closed until a button opens it

guidance.bestFor: A popover anchored under an outline trigger, with typed shortcuts and Apply and Cancel below the selector
agentNotes: `internalValue` is a draft that `handleCancel` discards; only `handleApply` copies it into `value`, so save from there

whenNotToUse.when: A choice that must block the page until it is confirmed

guidance.bestFor: A modal titled Select Due Date with a read only field, closing on Cancel or committing on Apply
agentNotes: `handleApply` copies the draft `internalValue` into local `value` state and closes; persist the date to your form or API there

whenNotToUse.when: A picker kept next to its trigger while the page stays usable

guidance.bestFor: A language menu switching English, Spanish, French and German labels, date format and first weekday
agentNotes: `translations` hardcodes the Spanish, French and German strings; load them from your own i18n catalog
`currentLanguage` starts as French and only the demo menu changes it; drive it from your app locale
Pass `currentI18n` and the locale `dateFormat` to `formatDateValue` as well, or the trigger label falls back to English names and MM/dd/yyyy

whenNotToUse.when: An app in one language with no locale switching
